flags.effect: Unbind the clients and folder routes that name the set first; clients follow the default access
flags.name: --detach

flags.effect: Delete the set only; the clients and folders that name it reach nothing until bound again
flags.name: --leave

flags.effect: Show the plan and change nothing
flags.name: --dry-run

summary: Delete an access set; one that clients or folders still name needs --detach (unbind them) or --leave (they reach nothing) <set> [--detach | --leave] [--dry-run]
